name: NeoHorse-1-4B

lineage.how_derived: routing-guided agentic post-training (curriculum SFT and on-policy distillation from execution trajectories collected by a routing harness); language-model weights only, vision removed

purpose: Initial prototype on the path toward recursive self-improvement: a 4B model post-trained for text-based agent harnesses, tool use, coding and instruction following (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Apache License 2.0 text read in the repo LICENSE file: commercial use, modification and redistribution allowed with notice and patent grant.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention dense transformer (Qwen3.5-4B layout)
architecture.attention: full attention every 4th layer, 16 Q / 4 KV heads, head dim 256

variants.notes: Q8_0 4.48 GB; a 9B sibling GGUF repo exists (TokenRhythm/NeoHorse-1-9B-GGUF)

pc-12gb.notes: 2.71 GB file fits the VRAM budget (9.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-16gb.notes: 2.71 GB file fits the VRAM budget (13.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-24gb.notes: 2.71 GB file fits the VRAM budget (21.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-32gb.notes: 2.71 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 2.71 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 2.71 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 2.71 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

strengths: +5.9 points macro average over its base in the vendor's own ten-benchmark set
weaknesses: the ten benchmarks are not named in the part of the card read; only the vendor's average
soft.maturity: 2.5k likes but only 2.5k downloads of the main repo; one technical report (arXiv tag 2609.08183)

tona_fit.reason: A 4B agent post-train of Qwen3.5-4B with an unverified average gain; at this size a stock Qwen3.5-4B or Gemma 4 E4B is the baseline to beat. Apache-2.0 (text read).

open_questions: which ten benchmarks and their individual scores
